page.layout: One page of text, single column, with italic verse epigraph at top, a centred heading, a drop-capped poem below, and a signature line at the foot right. No marginal notes.

p.i: Sic memor officij Veteris, Veterisque magistri. Lampada qui extrema moriens sibi tradidit hora Effet Apollinei deinde Vt Pars maxima cætus, Magna opere in tato & parte memoratus haberet. Nec dubium parili fuerint si anale fla labore Quæ iam sparsa situ sordent carieque sepulta Fœlici purgata manu, quin Viuet Viterque Æternum, Vt meritus, chartis immortuus, auum.

main_text.head: GVLIELMO SCOTO ROLLO-CEORUM SCRIPTORUM ASSERTORI.
main_text.p: TVis aufpiciis, Amice magne, Qui mancus, mutilus, lacer, iacebat, Orbatus citius suo parente Quàm lucem aspiceret liber misellus, Nunc sartus, nitidus, venustulúsque, Succo & Nectare, per Librariorum Prostat scrinia, tectus, integellus: Sic vt nec sycophantias malorum Omneis vnius æstimet vel assis. Absque te foret hic liber disertus (Certum μνημόσυνον tui sodalis, Qui solatiolum fuit Sophorum, Non horum modò, sed quot aut fuerunt, Aut posthac aliis erunt in annis) Depastus tineis malas tenebras Indignè incoleret tenebricosus. Perge vindicias tui clientis Sic postliminio parare Chartis, Famæ vt vindicias tibi clienti Laus postliminio parare pergat.

page.notes: Verse epigraph and poem partly italic; long s rendered as s; "Io. Rayus." set right-aligned as a signature. The word "Vt" in epigraph and "Viuet" are printed as such. Some letters in the lower poem are faint and may be misread.
